snippet.title: KUBIKA - Announcement Teaser (Q3 2026)
snippet.description:
🧊 Wishlist KUBIKA on Steam now: 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4384150/KUBIKA/

Welcome to Kubika, an adorable 3D puzzle game inspired by Sokoban. Guide cute cubes through stylized worlds and solve mind-bending logic puzzles in a vibrant, zen atmosphere.

Experience a relaxing journey where perspective is key. There are no timers and no stress.
Just you, the logic, and the satisfaction of solving the perfect puzzle.

Coming Q3 2026 on PC with full Steam Deck support! 🎮

#Kubika #IndieGame #PuzzleGame #Sokoban #CozyGame #SteamDeck #Steam
